rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken way to say that someone is not allowed to do something.

example.english: My mum can prohibit me from going out today.
example.traditional: 阿媽話我今日唔准出街。
example.jyutping: aa3 maa1 waa6 ngo5 gam1 jat6 m4 zeon2 ceot1 gaai1

rows.note: Use this for official rules, signs, regulations, or formal statements that ban something.

example.english: The notice at the entrance says, “We prohibit smoking.”
example.traditional: 門口塊告示寫住禁止吸煙。
example.jyutping: mun4 hau2 faai3 gou3 si6 se2 zyu6 gam3 zi2 kap1 jin1
